summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a C$17.5M funding agreement with Invest Ontario, an agency of the Government of Ontario, to support construction of its cobalt sulfate refinery. This is a routine funding/contract announcement, not a special-situation corporate event. No securities transaction, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a standard report of a foreign private issuer and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
